notes.title: Release date has been officially announced!
notes.notes:
Hi again everyone,

We are very happy to announce that GOD WARS The Complete Legend is slated for release on June the 14th 2019!

We will have a wonderful art book and bundle packages with great discount prices available.

Please stay tuned for more from KADOKAWA GAMES and GOD WARS The Complete Legend!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34793118/57d90278108729e0bae6f21b63cb91be5c3f45c7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Features and Functions for the Steam Version 3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I forgot to mention about changing the direction your characters are facing by just using your mouse.
Hover over your cursor to the character and click on the direction you want to face it: It's so easy in the Steam version.

Ooops, but be careful. You don't want to show your back towards the enemy.
You'll sustain 1.5 times more damage than you would normally sustain from the front; Try to face your characters to the enemy at all cost.

We have a new video introducing the other features as well so please stay tuned!! Matane (See You Later in Japanese)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34793118/362951d2426f8a428bb7ae1b1f85a23ed690fb59.png[/img]

notes.title: Features and Functions for the Steam Version ２
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Please say hi to Orihime! Isn't she just adorable?

You can now use your mouse to scroll up and down a list just like the one shown here In the Steam version.
Just simply drag the scroll bar for smooth movement.

But you could always use your normal controller and buttons if you prefer to.

Talk to you all tomorrow!!

notes.title: Features and Functions for the Steam Version 1
notes.notes:
Konnichiwa, everyone!

Let me simply introduce one of the features for the Steam version 
of GOD WARS The Complete Legend.

The screenshot below is in Japanese (Sorry!) but please refer to it.

As shown, if you hover the cursor over to where the "Wind God" icon is, the status can be easily checked and confirmed.

You can now use your mouse and keyboard in the Steam version so it's so easy to move your cursor around your PC screen!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34793118/9e0d49f5c9cb61baad6385003164bcb6a0d01647.png[/img]
